other_conditions: Must be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker)
Must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Must not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law
Must not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF), National Pension System (NPS), or Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC)
Must not be an income tax payer
Must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab or a family member of such a worker
Must be suffering from any primary disease
benefits_summary: Primary health facilities are provided to construction workers and their families in urban health kiosks located in slum areas.
